correctness.rationale: The complete theorem follows algebraically on the stated nonempty parameter open set. The exact Hessian factorization identifies all divisorial critical sources and the sole contracted source line; the cubic discriminant makes the three source conics distinct and smooth, the three auxiliary resultants exclude degeneracies, the critical-image resultant gives the sextic, and the binary-cubic discriminant plus coefficients gives three distinct nonzero smooth image conics. A general point has exactly three preimages by the cubic fiber equation. All critical polynomial identities are independently checked by the included exact symbolic program. Exceptional parameters and scheme-theoretic resolution effects are excluded explicitly.

value.rationale: For the simplest nontrivial two-conic member of the bitangent-pencil arrangement singled out by Beorchia--Miró-Roig, the theorem determines the entire natural reduced divisorial critical-value locus and identifies a second bitangent pencil, giving the exact ramification geometry of a generically three-to-one polar map. This answers a motivated geometric gap, supplies stable parameter conditions, and allows meaningful future degeneration and monodromy study; the content is not just freeness arithmetic or an isolated computation.
